definitions.explanation: The final part or extremity of something.
What will happen eventually; the outcome after a process.
The final part of a time period (month, year, etc.).

examples.japanese: {月|つき}{末|すえ}までに{提出|ていしゅつ}してください。
examples.english: Please submit by the end of the month.

examples.japanese: {長|なが}い{議論|ぎろん}の{末|すえ}、{結論|けつろん}が{出|で}た。
examples.english: After a long discussion, a conclusion was reached.

examples.japanese: {指|ゆび}の{末|すえ}まで{冷|つめ}たい。
examples.english: It's cold down to my fingertips.

examples.japanese: {枝|えだ}の{末|すえ}に{小|ちい}さな{花|はな}が{咲|さ}いている。
examples.english: Small flowers are blooming at the tip of the branch.

examples.japanese: {子孫|しそん}の{末|すえ}まで{語|かた}り{継|つ}ぐべき{物語|ものがたり}だ。
examples.english: It's a story that should be passed down to future generations.

examples.japanese: {苦労|くろう}の{末|すえ}に{成功|せいこう}をつかんだ。
examples.english: After much hardship, they achieved success.

examples.japanese: {悩|なや}んだ{末|すえ}、{転職|てんしょく}を{決意|けつい}した。
examples.english: After much deliberation, I decided to change jobs.

examples.japanese: {年|ねん}の{末|すえ}は{忙|いそが}しくなる。
examples.english: The end of the year gets busy.

examples.japanese: {今月|こんげつ}{末|すえ}で{契約|けいやく}が{切|き}れる。
examples.english: The contract expires at the end of this month.

notes:
{末|すえ} indicates the end or conclusion of something.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ～の{末|すえ}（に） (after..., at the end of...)
- {月|つき}{末|すえ} (end of the month)
- {年|ねん}{末|すえ} (end of the year)
- {週|しゅう}{末|すえ} (weekend) - note: pronounced まつ in this compound

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {将来|しょうらい}の{末|すえ} (in the future, eventually)
- {苦労|くろう}の{末|すえ} (after much hardship)
- {議論|ぎろん}の{末|すえ} (after discussion)

READING NOTE:
- {末|すえ}: kun'yomi, used independently or in patterns like ～の{末|すえ}
- {末|まつ}: on'yomi, used in compounds like {週末|しゅうまつ}, {月末|げつまつ}
